with q as (select l.link_id, b.issue_key bug, o.issue_key lk from model.issue_link l join model.issue b on b.issue_key = case when l.inward_label='is blocked by' then l.to_issue_key else l.from_issue_key end join model.issue o on o.issue_key = case when l.inward_label='is blocked by' then l.from_issue_key else l.to_issue_key end where (l.inward_label='is blocked by' or l.outward_label='depends on') and b.issue_type_name='Bug' and b.priority_name='Highest' and coalesce(b.resolution_name,'')='' and coalesce(o.resolution_name,'')='') select link_id, bug as issue, (select count(distinct bug) from q) as value from q union select link_id, lk, (select count(distinct bug) from q) from q
